claims: WrestleMania 42 will take place on Saturday, April 18, 2026, and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 will take place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Paradise, Nevada.
Both nights of WrestleMania 42 begin at 6 p.m. ET.
Both nights of WrestleMania 42 begin at 3 p.m. PT.
WrestleMania 42 Night 1 main event is Cody Rhodes (c) vs. Randy Orton (Undisputed WWE Championship).
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 main event is CM Punk (c) vs. Roman Reigns (World Heavyweight Championship).
WrestleMania 42 includes Logan Paul/Austin Theory/IShowSpeed vs. The Usos/LA Knight.
WrestleMania 42 includes Jacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyre (Unsanctioned).
The 2026 Hall of Fame ceremony features inductees like Stephanie McMahon.
2-Day Combo tickets for WrestleMania 42 are available on Ticketmaster.
WWE Friday Night SmackDown is on Friday, April 17, 2026.
WWE Monday Night RAW is on Monday, April 20, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on Netflix internationally.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on ESPN in the US.
In the United States, WrestleMania 42 is available on ESPN streaming services such as ESPN+ or through premium TV packages.
